chunk: Company Policy All employees must follow data security procedures. Passwords should not be shared. Sensitive customer information must be protected. Employees should report security incidents immediately.

Employee Handbook Employees are expected to maintain professional conduct. Attendance should be regular and punctual. Team collaboration and communication are encouraged. Training opportunities are available throughout the year.

Artificial Intelligence Notes Artificial Intelligence enables machines to perform tasks that typically require human intelligence. Machine learning is a subset of artificial intelligence. Deep learning uses neural networks with multiple layers.
